policy.definition_authority: CMI source page / official indicator specification
policy.value_independence: Definition metadata remains usable even when a hospital-year observed value is missing.
policy.hosxp_mapping: Map CMI numerator/denominator conditions to logical HOSxP/HIS concepts. Physical table/field names are site/version mappings and must be verified locally.
policy.formula_rule: Use the formula represented by CMI numerator/denominator/output columns; never invent missing clinical inclusion criteria.
